title: The larger hamlet, a later longing for a child
about: `hamlet-6` with the world's own values of two laws (world.rules), as in `hamlet-longing`: `longing_after_min` 120 (shipped 20) and `longing_food` 4 (shipped 0). The longing for a child is felt 120 real minutes after one's own birth or one's youngest child's, shortened by nurture, and only while carrying at least 4 food. What a body can do is unchanged.
